tier: Taiwan HiNet dynamic home broadband 1 Gbps (TWHInet-G-Mini)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. A third-party review of the vendor's storefront on 2026-10-25 lists TWHInet-G-Mini at 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM and 12 GB disk, unlimited traffic on a shared 1 Gbps port, one HiNet dynamic residential IPv4 that can be changed manually or on a schedule and no IPv6, at ¥420 a month, ¥336 with a referral code (the review's 8 折 on every term, which is 20 percent off). The currency of the yen sign is not stated by the review. The vendor's own storefront renders client-side and returned no plan text to a read.
free_tier.notes: unverified: the price and the plan rows are the review's reading of the vendor's storefront. The vendor's own page at shlii.io is a client-rendered application whose captured text is only the loading message and a site name.

retention.stated: not applicable: a rented machine and its address, not stored bytes

egress.terms: Unlimited traffic on a shared 1 Gbps port (1024M in and out), per the review's reading of the plan. The review says the vendor bans airport-style proxy services and heavy relay buyers, and that port 25 does not connect.
egress.free_allowance: unlimited traffic on a shared 1 Gbps port, per a third-party review

interface_detail: A virtual machine or container on an Incus-based console (the review's description of the platform) with one dynamic HiNet IPv4 and no IPv6. The vendor's own console was not readable, so the access method and any API are unverified.
tooling: An SSH client plus a proxy or tunnel daemon the user installs on the machine. The review describes the machine as suited to proxy landing, remote desktop and background accounts. The vendor's API, if any, is unverified.
chaining: A Worker opens an outbound connection to the machine and the machine makes the upstream request from a Taiwanese HiNet address, which the review says changes on request, so the upstream sees an address in Chunghwa Telecom's network instead of AS13335.

limits.value: shared 1 Gbps port (1024M in and 1024M out) on the TWHInet-G-Mini plan, per a third-party review

limits_note: The plan terms come from a third-party review with an affiliate link, not from the vendor's pages. The review states no refunds, shared bandwidth with an independent IP, and a ban on airport-style relay and large forwarding buyers. A different domain, shlii.com, is an unrelated toy shop and is not this vendor.
binding_note: No byte allowance is stated, so none binds. The deciding facts are the unverified registration class and that the vendor's own pages could not be read.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the vendor's sign-up and checkout pages were not readable. The kind records an email as the floor.

reliability_note: The review ran one machine on 2026-10-25 and 2026-10-26 and rates it for Taiwan platforms; nothing on delivered throughput or uptime beyond that run is recorded.
confidence_note: Reported. The plan row, price and address class come from a single third-party review. The vendor's own page was a client-rendered shell. Nothing was measured and no registry lookup was possible because no address is published.
